scope:
Offline bridge-byte parity and throughput against frozen pre-change code.

Reads exact source-time TF directly from SQLite. No bag player, controller or
executor. Geometry service timings exclude disk, deserialization and hashing.
publication_policy: Skip only zero-subscriber work; offline/explicit captures retained. No equal-stamp deduplication.
limits: No ARM/vehicle timing, DDS or full pipeline rate measurement.
Previously recorded source input stays unchanged.
All slow timing samples retained, including 1-thread original P95 outliers.
No simulation, hardware, controllers, weekly form, commit or upload.
